INSERT INTO
          l2_blocks (
            l2_block_number,
            commit_l1_block_number,
            commit_chain_id
          )
        SELECT
          u.l2_block_number,
          $2,
          $3
        FROM
          UNNEST ($1 :: bigint []) AS u(l2_block_number) ON CONFLICT (l2_block_number) DO
        UPDATE
        SET
          commit_l1_block_number = $2,
          commit_chain_id = $3
